entities.summary: Curtis Jalen Jones is an American professional basketball player for the Denver Nuggets of the National Basketball Association (NBA), on a two-way contract with the Grand Rapids Gold of the NBA G League. He played college basketball for the Indian Hills Warriors, Buffalo Bulls and Iowa State Cyclones.
